name: rocket
description: The Energy fleet's release-engineering employee. Wires actionlint-clean GitHub Actions CI/CD into any repo, audits a workflow for the 2026 supply-chain attack classes (mutable-tag / transitive-pin / pwn-request / cache-poison / OIDC-misconfig), verifies a deploy along both axes (right artifact live AND live artifact behaves), executes the rollback hierarchy fastest-first, and gates agent releases on regression-not-floor. Verify, don't trust the checkmark. Owns the pipeline and the deploy only; product features go to pixel/turbo/pebble.
author: Energy Platform

mcp_servers.name: rocket
mcp_servers.description: rocket's own release-engineering tools over JSON-RPC (stdio) — rocket_wire / rocket_audit / rocket_verify / rocket_rollback / rocket_eval_gate / rocket_migrate_plan / rocket_preview_reap. Thin wrappers over the SAME core functions the rocket CLI calls (one implementation, two surfaces — the MCP tools never drift from the gated CLI). Long-running calls (verify, eval_gate) carry the MCP Tasks-primitive promotion seam (call-now/fetch-later, 2025-11-25 spec).

commands.name: wire
commands.description: THE acceptance test: generate a valid, actionlint-clean GHA workflow + deploy config for a repo (detect -> generate -> validate -> commit -> verify, per-step gates); commit it. Default lane = Vercel.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: run the J3 attack-class sweep (mutable-tag / pwn-request / cache-poison / OIDC-misconfig) + actionlint + zizmor; emit P0/P1 findings + SHA-pin fixes. Never reports 'all pinned' from a top-level scan (transitive gap).

commands.name: verify
commands.description: both-axes deploy check: (a) deployed SHA == HEAD (curl + compare), (b) behavior smoke (real path + config defaults, not just 200). Emit GO/NO-GO. Refuses to read a checkmark; NO-GO under uncertainty, never GO.

commands.name: rollback
commands.description: execute the rollback hierarchy fastest-first (flag -> alias-repoint -> image-pin -> git-revert); print the prior-good ID captured at deploy. (Fly has no one-command rollback — image-pin.)

commands.name: eval-gate
commands.description: run the eval pyramid on agent/prompt changes; gate on REGRESSION vs a rolling baseline + absolute floor (dual threshold, Welch's-t); noSelfGrading. --seed-baseline writes the committed eval/baseline.json.

commands.name: migrate-plan
commands.description: classify a schema diff; emit the expand-contract 3-phase plan; REFUSE a destructive change in the same deploy as dependent code (un-rollback-able by construction). PLAN-ONLY — acorn owns the schema.

commands.name: preview
commands.description: tear down leaked preview environments (the reaper the platform won't run); list orphans first.

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: self-check: act/actionlint/zizmor/gh installed, secrets present (tier), brain searchable, eval pyramid green.

tools.name: rocket_wire
tools.description: THE acceptance test over MCP: generate an actionlint-clean GHA workflow + deploy config for a repo and commit it. Maps to `rocket wire`.
tools.when_to_use: When you want CI/CD wired into a repo — a valid GitHub Actions workflow plus a deploy config, with a 2nd-commit preview.

tools.name: rocket_audit
tools.description: Run the attack-class sweep + actionlint + zizmor over a repo's workflows; findings keyed by severity (P0/P1) with SHA-pin fixes. Maps to `rocket audit`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need to know whether a CI workflow is safe — mutable-tag, transitive-pin, pwn-request, cache-poison, or OIDC misconfig — before shipping.

tools.name: rocket_verify
tools.description: Both-axes deploy check (deployed SHA == HEAD + behavior smoke); emits GO/NO-GO; refuses to read a checkmark. Maps to `rocket verify`.
tools.when_to_use: When you want to know if a deploy actually went live AND behaves — not whether CI is green.

tools.name: rocket_rollback
tools.description: Execute the rollback hierarchy fastest-first (flag -> alias-repoint -> image-pin -> git-revert). Maps to `rocket rollback`.
tools.when_to_use: When a deploy is bad and you want the fastest safe rollback path for the target's platform.

tools.name: rocket_eval_gate
tools.description: Run the eval pyramid and gate on regression vs a rolling baseline + absolute floor (dual threshold, Welch's-t); noSelfGrading. Maps to `rocket eval-gate`.
tools.when_to_use: When you want to gate an agent/prompt change on quality regression, not an absolute floor that lets slow drift slip under it.

tools.name: rocket_migrate_plan
tools.description: Classify a schema diff and emit the expand-contract 3-phase plan; refuses a destructive change coupled with dependent code. Maps to `rocket migrate-plan`.
tools.when_to_use: When you have a schema change and want a rollback-able migration ordering (expand/contract) before deploying.

tools.name: rocket_preview_reap
tools.description: Tear down leaked preview environments (lists orphans first). Maps to `rocket preview reap`.
tools.when_to_use: When preview environments are accumulating beyond open PRs and need the teardown reaper the platform won't run.

install_instructions:
1. Build the package: pnpm install && pnpm --filter rocket build (or: cd tools/rocket && pnpm install && pnpm build).
2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings -> Plugins -> Add local plugin -> select this directory (or `claude plugin install rocket`).
3. The rocket CLI (wire/audit/verify/rollback/eval-gate/migrate-plan/preview/doctor), the rocket MCP server (7 tools), the 5 skills (deploy-verify, workflow-audit, rollback-runbook, migration-safety, eval-gate-design), the house-law guard + SessionStart hooks, and the 2 sub-agent personas (pipeline-auditor + deploy-verifier) are now available.
